title: 卡帕西用Claude两小时重做了YouTube，每个人都能拥有一个自己的互联网
content: Andrej Karpathy built HackerTube, a YouTube alternative, in two hours using Claude Opus 5.5. The platform curates videos based on Hacker News recommendations rather than engagement metrics, prioritizing community vetting over algorithmic feeds. It lacks login requirements and uses simple video frames as thumbnails. Although it relies on existing YouTube data and Hacker News history, this project demonstrates how AI agents can rapidly restructure information distribution. By shifting control from platform algorithms to individual preferences, it highlights the potential for personalized, user-centric curation tools that redefine how users access and interact with digital content.
